MagicalRsq-X ancestry-aware quality filter; call-rate filters
Re-impute the merged set to fill intersection gaps
HWE / MAF / heterozygosity filters, relatedness, PCA
GRAF-anc + ADMIXTURE global; RFMix / FLARE / G-NOMIX local ancestry
Imputation vs WGS truth; strategies A–F × 3 servers; GCTA simulations
Illustrative outputs: values are schematic, not results
PLINK / VCF · global ancestry calls · local ancestry tracts · QC & benchmark reports
Nextflow_GWAS_pipeline · subworkflows toggled on or off by parameters
Harmonized genotypes, phenotypes, covariates, ancestry calls
PLINK2 QC; GRAF-anc groups; ancestry × trait run in parallel
REGENIE / SAIGE / GENESIS; Tractor for admixed; SPA-Cox survival
PolyFun + SuSiE within; MG-FLASH-FM / SuSiE-ME across ancestries
PRS, heritability / rg, colocalization, MAGMA / FUMA annotation
Manhattan, QQ, regional plots; MultiQC and HTML report
summary statistics · credible sets · PRS weights · h² / rg · colocalized QTLs
What the framework changes relative to a typical GWAS workflow
Nextflow, containerized, parameterized end to end
Fixed R² cut-off for all samples
GRAF-anc (282K SNPs) plus local ancestry inference
External, post hoc if done at all
Built in at each step; dedicated benchmarking module
Every module is an independent Nextflow DSL2 entry point: run end-to-end, resume from any module, or run one module on existing outputs.
Containerized (Apptainer / Singularity / Docker); HPC / SLURM ready.
